quarantine.title: F5 and Ctrl+R never reload the app and a release build opens no DevTools
quarantine.reason: Windows/WebView2 only: the injected F12 accelerator intermittently opens a DevTools window and, less often, a reload races the assertion (four failures 2026-09-22..23, none reproducible on Linux). Excluded from the required run until the WebView2 accelerator keys are disabled or the check stops racing the browser process.
